decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to three outbound emails (email:1423ced4, email:3835ae0e, email:a9b913c3). Starter plan, single admin, no signal of intent. Silent accounts this far in rarely self-activate within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

I know a couple of notes have come your way already, so I'll keep this short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the thing that makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you live, or answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
